title: Privacy and Data Usage Policy Change
description: Starting April 24, 2026, GitHub began using interaction data from Copilot Free, Pro, and Pro+ users to improve the service. Data being collected includes inputs, code snippets, prompts, and suggestions. Users can opt out in settings under 'Privacy'.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot 宣布自4月24日起，将使用个人交互数据来训练大模型

title: v0.37.0 - Dynamic Sandbox Expansion
description: Released April 8, 2026 with dynamic sandbox expansion and worktree support for Linux and Windows, implementing major architectural improvements to the CLI environment.

title: v0.37.1 - Enhanced Browser Agent
description: Latest stable release introducing an Enhanced Browser Agent with persistent session management, dynamic read-only tool discovery, and sandbox-aware initialization for the browser.

title: Bugbot Learned Rules and MCP Support
description: Released April 8, 2026 with enhanced Bugbot capabilities including ability to self-improve in real time, MCP (Model Context Protocol) support, and improvements to Bugbot Autofix with its highest resolution rate yet. Bugbot can now learn from feedback on pull requests and convert those signals into learned rules.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor reached $500M ARR and $10B valuation in 2025, making AI-powered coding the new standard for developer productivity

title: Adaptive Model Router Bug Fix
description: Fixed a bug with the adaptive model router on April 6, 2026 in Windsurf Editor that was preventing model switching after the first request. The same fix was rolled out to Windsurf Next extension on April 7 and JetBrains extension on April 8. All affected users had their quota reset as compensation.

community_feedback.quote: Anyone tried Windsurf's new 'Adaptive' model yet? Windsurf just rolled out this new feature that supposedly balances cost + quality

title: April 4, 2026 OAuth Token Policy Change
description: Anthropic changed policy on April 4, 2026, making Claude Pro and Max subscription OAuth tokens no longer work in third-party tools. This restricts usage of paid Claude subscriptions to official channels only, affecting tools like OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Crush.

community_feedback.quote: PSA: Using Claude Code OAuth in third-party tools (OpenCode, Crush, etc.) risks account bans - Anthropic is cracking down on unofficial tools
Users expressed confusion about why using their paid Claude.ai quota through third-party apps would be considered a 'violation of terms of service'
Many users described the policy enforcement as 'scummy' for restricting paid usage
This appears to be a move to restrict usage of paid Claude subscriptions outside of official channels

title: New Cursor Interface
description: Major UI/UX overhaul to the Cursor interface released April 2, 2026, enhancing user experience and workflow improvements.

title: Visual Studio Extensibility Improvements
description: March 2026 update brought major enhancements for Visual Studio users including custom agents, agent skills, and new tools for extensibility in the Visual Studio environment.

title: Multi-Agent Code Review Tool Launch
description: Anthropic launched a dedicated multi-agent code review system for Claude Code to address the surge in pull requests driven by AI coding tools, enhancing collaborative code review capabilities.

community_feedback.quote: I've been happily using Claude projects for most of my prototyping. I'm hoping I can use it directly in VS Code
We started with GitHub Copilot, but it was largely replaced by Claude Code - particularly its ability to execute scripts
Ask HN: Why does it look like everyone is abandoning GitHub Copilot? Most people are using Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code instead
